itemized.notes: 4-page filing, standard shape: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (already transcribed), p3 Schedule A ('Page 3 of 4'), p4 Schedule B ('Page 4 of 4'). Handwritten in block capitals. THIS IS THE ONE FILING IN THE CHUNK WHERE THE PAGE-SUBTOTAL GATE CHANGED A VALUE - see page_subtotal_gates; the corrected figure is 1495.90 and it is recorded as a re-read, not as an adjustment to make the page balance. Both contribution rows are union money (Utah AFL-CIO Central Federation $500 and Utah AFL-CIO Iron Workers Local 27 $250), and both have their mailing address covered by a solid BLACK-BOX county redaction - donor_city/donor_state blank because redacted. Both donor cells wrap over two written lines and are rejoined as printed. The Occupation/Employer column is empty on both rows (a union is not a person). Expenditure oddities kept verbatim: 'MAGNATIC SIGNS', 'PROPOENENT INC', and a self-correction on the last row where 'DONATION' is struck through and replaced by 'REGISTRATION'. The Schedule A SUBTOTAL cell is blank while its TOTAL is filled - the reverse of the usual omission - so the schedule total carries the gate on that side. Context from the earlier totals pass: this is the ORIGINAL June report (the clerk listing calls it a primary-election interim; the form's own Date of Report is 6.19.12), and its Column B aggregate cells are blank where a later amendment filled them in.
